shellCommands.command: cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat package.json | grep '"version"'; grep -rn "lang" build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls build/esm/components/utils/ | head -50; cat build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -rln "export.*Lang\b\|configure" build/esm/index.d.ts build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null

cat build/esm/components/theme/useLang.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/useLang.js build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts build/esm/utils/configure.js; ls build/esm/i18n* 2>/dev/null; find build/esm -path '*i18n*' -maxdepth 3 | head; grep -n "useLang\|LangContext" build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts
cat build/esm/i18n/i18n.js | head -60; ls build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n 2>/dev/null; cat build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/ru.json build/esm/components/Select/i18n/ru.json 2>/dev/null

cat build/esm/components/index.d.ts | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 4000; echo; sed -n 1,60p build/esm/components/Pagination/types.d.ts; cat build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head -30
sed -i 's| lang={code}>|>\n {LANGUAGE_NAMES[code]}|; /^ {LANGUAGE_NAMES\[code\]}$/d' src/LanguageSwitcher.tsx && sed -n 17,24p src/LanguageSwitcher.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8
ls node_modules | grep -iE "playwright|puppeteer|jsdom|happy-dom|testing-library"; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null

mkdir -p .tmpcheck && sed 's|/home/sandbox/workspace/src/App|../src/App|' /tmp/i18ncheck/ssr.test.tsx > .tmpcheck/ssr.test.tsx && timeout 100 npx vitest run .tmpcheck/ssr.test.tsx 2>&1 | tail -20; rm -rf .tmpcheck /tmp/i18ncheck
